Everything alive on Dash:

Gas on one new chain hit ~$0.40 this week, over double Ethereum. Dash doesn't auction gas: fees are near-flat and InstantSend locks payments in ~2s via masternodes. Trade-off: Dash gives up a flexible fee market for predictable cost.

Most chains use general-purpose smart contracts—flexible, but code bugs can lose funds. Dash uses declarative data contracts—schema-enforced, but no arbitrary on-chain logic. Trade-off: flexibility vs verifiability.

See clearly. Give everything.:

The proof is the product. Surface DAPI's cryptographic proof every query — let users verify data without trusting you. That loop is trust you'd otherwise spend years earning. Accumulate identity IDs: they carry credits, names, documents.
